verdict.rationale: Installing apps from an official software catalog is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes an official app catalog or store for macOS. Mentions of third-party apps such as Adobe InDesign, Affinity Photo 2 and Moom say nothing about installing them from an official catalog, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install thousands of applications directly from an official software catalog
